name: python-retry-budget
title: Error budget and burn-rate pages you can defend
blurb: An SLO of 99.9% is a budget of one bad event in a thousand. This turns bucket counts into that budget, its burn rate and a two-window page rule: the long window says something is wrong, the short window says it is still wrong. Silence is reported as missing, not as success, and a window with no traffic has no burn rate at all instead of a reassuring zero.
default_description: Turn an SLO target into an error budget, a burn rate, and pages that do not flap.
